replaces: issue #1450: no case reached a located reader refusal through inspect-source-records
fails_if: `_cmd_inspect_source_records` (cli.py) broadens either wrap around `inspect_bundle_source_records` or `write_scb_observation_census` beyond SnapshotError (say `except (SnapshotError, RegMetaError)` or `except ValueError`), so the located scb_native_id_invalid refusal is reported as source_record_inspection_invalid
note: One LISA Registerinformation row (register 34, variant 153) carries the non-numeric RegVerID `v1`, the first data row, so `_scb_native_id` refuses at row 2. Run 1 is the focused report, which reads the selected workbook and then the LISA rows of Registerinformation; it writes its error envelope with `--output`. Run 2 is the all-SCB census, which reads every Registerinformation row; it prints its envelope. Both pass the located code through, because only a SnapshotError maps to source_record_inspection_invalid. The issue named scb_value_shape_unsupported as the example, but this command excludes the Vardemangder value streams (InspectionScope.excluded_inputs), so that refusal cannot reach it; a LISA format refusal (LisaWorkbookError) is also a SnapshotError and is wrapped. The located SCB record refusal is the reachable one. The message text comes from `_scb_native_id`'s format string and the row position.
